Production capability for custom stone orders and export programs.

WHITEROCK's Vietnam factory is the primary production base, supported by OPTIMA STONE in Yunfu, China. Together they support drawing review, fabrication, quality checks, labeling, and shipment-ready packing.

Processing Capability

What buyers can specify for OEM, ODM, and project work.

Cut-to-size & calibration

Straight cutting, thickness calibration, and repeat production. Final tolerance is confirmed by approved drawing and order specification.

CNC fabrication

Sink cutouts, faucet/drain holes, drainboards, curved pieces, and shaped components from approved drawings.

Edges & lamination

Eased, bevel, bullnose, ogee, mitered/laminated, waterfall, and approved custom profiles.

Project production

Large-format and BOQ-based production with dimensional tolerance and flatness standards confirmed before production.

Review finishes and edge profiles →

Production Flow

Controlled from material approval to container-ready packing.

01

Material Selection

Confirm category, color, thickness, finish, sample reference, slab lot, and traceability requirements.

02

Cutting & CNC

Plan yield, cut to size, machine openings, and process approved shaped pieces.

03

Edge & Surface

Complete profiles, lamination, polishing or honing, cleaning, and in-process checks.

04

Inspection & Export

Check dimensions and finish, label pieces, protect edges, crate, and plan container loading.

Quality Control & Lab

Inspection points buyers can audit.

  • Incoming slab and lot review
  • In-process dimensional checks
  • Pre-packing finish and edge review
  • Pre-shipment quantity and label check
AQL sampling
Sampling plan confirmed per order or buyer inspection requirement.
Measuring tools
Calipers, gauges, templates, and flatness tools used for routine dimensional checks; full tool list pending owner confirmation.
Third-party inspection
Third-party inspection by SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek, or a buyer-appointed inspector is welcome by arrangement.

R&D / Design

Development support for private-label programs.

  • Drawing-based and reverse-from-sample development
  • Sample development and color matching
  • 3D modeling / shop drawings support; software and team size pending owner confirmation
  • OEM/ODM and private-label product development

Sample-development lead time: Confirmed by sample scope and material availability

Materials & Sourcing

Lot selection and repeat-order traceability.

Material lots are reviewed against the approved sample and order requirements. Natural stone variation is documented by lot; engineered materials are sourced against the approved color and specification.

Traceability: Lot coding and repeat-order traceability are documented during order review; final process details pending owner confirmation.

Packing & Container Loading

Protection designed around the SKU.

Packing routes can include foam, corner guards, inner cartons, labeled plywood crates, pallets, or A-frames according to product weight and shipment method.

Container loadability and pieces per crate are confirmed per SKU and drawing; final load plans are issued before shipment.
